events.description: Rachel Green says Paolo is the person she is introducing to everyone.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green wants Paolo to meet Rachel Green's friends.
Rachel Green says Paolo is going to meet Rachel Green's friends.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller is the person she is introducing to Paolo.
Rachel Green says Paolo does not speak much English.
Rachel Green tells everyone to look at Paolo recognizing the game 'Monopoly'.
Ross Geller asks where Paolo came from.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green thinks Paolo came from Italy.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller means where Paolo came from tonight in the building and how Paolo suddenly came into the lives of Ross Geller, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller.
Rachel Green says the cat turned out to be Paolo's cat.
Ross Geller says the fact that the cat turned out to be Paolo's cat is funny.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green keeps touching Paolo.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay looked all over the building.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay could not find the cat anywhere.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green found the cat.
Rachel Green says the cat was Paolo's cat.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green now has an explanation for the cat situation.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is guessing that the man Rachel Green brought is Paolo.
Phoebe Buffay says nobody told Phoebe Buffay about Paolo.
Rachel Green says Phoebe Buffay is the person she is introducing to Paolo.
Phoebe Buffay tells Paolo he can bet on it, agreeing emphatically.
